metadata.title: Engineering
metadata.description: G.M. Consolidated in-house engineering and capabilities — concept, 3D modelling, prototyping, validation, tooling and production, managed under one roof.

header.title: From Concept to Commercial-Ready.
header.intro: Every stage of the journey — design, modelling, prototyping, validation, tooling and production — is managed in-house, so products get out first time right.

steps.title: Concept
steps.text: Design engineers translate complex client requirements into efficient, workable concepts — balancing function, aesthetics, ergonomics and economics.

steps.title: 3D Modelling
steps.text: Blueprints become complete 3D CAD models with the internal capability to transition directly into customised tooling structures.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.text: 3D-printed components create mock samples that validate each design — put under actual tests and conditions to simulate real performance.

steps.title: Validation
steps.text: Validation comes before any tooling activity — it is what gets products out first time right.

steps.title: Tooling
steps.text: A state-of-the-art tool room manufactures plastic injection moulds, die-casting moulds and press tools — repaired and maintained in-house.

steps.title: Production
steps.text: Dedicated product-specific lines for dry iron, steam iron, geyser, room heater, hair dryer and electric kettle run under one roof.

items.name: Pressure die casting
items.text: 120–250 ton PDC machines producing soleplates for dry and steam irons.

items.name: Plastic injection moulding
items.text: 25 machines from 80–400 ton running PC, PA6/PA66, PBT, ABS and PP engineering plastics, including insert moulding.

items.name: Press shop
items.text: Automatic sheet feeders and progressive tooling for high-volume components.

items.name: Tool room
items.text: CNC vertical machining (BFW) and EDM for world-class moulds — serving domestic and export markets for 20+ years.

items.name: PTFE coating
items.text: In-house non-stick surface processing for superior soleplate performance.

items.name: Thermostat manufacturing
items.text: Snap-action thermostats built in-house to a manufacturing capacity of 4 million.

items.name: Heating elements
items.text: Resistance wire, MGO filling, spot welding, plus SS304 instant water heater plates with argon welding.

items.name: Steam iron pump kits
items.text: The first manufacturer of steam iron pumps in India — produced entirely in-house.

cta.title: Planning a new product line?
cta.text: Bring the requirement — we will come back with engineering perspective, capability fit and next steps.
